title: Support a custom FLUTTER_STORAGE_BASE_URL as the source for Flutter package downloads
notes: Closed as not planned. FVM installs through Git by design. Custom Git remotes are already supported via fvm config --flutter-url, FVM_FLUTTER_URL, and FLUTTER_GIT_URL. Archive-based installs from FLUTTER_STORAGE_BASE_URL mirrors are out of scope. PR #1013 explored that work and was closed unmerged on 2026-08-19.
